observations.text: A gateway response timeout was recorded.
Route telemetry recorded 7 timeouts across 25 attempts, compared with 2 across 100 baseline attempts.

hypotheses.text: Observed route conditions may have contributed to the gateway timeout; root cause is unverified.
alternatives: A transaction-specific response loss may be unrelated to route-wide conditions.
Recipient credit cannot be established from a timeout.

unknowns: Authoritative beneficiary-credit outcome is not established.
